Biotech Innovation Prize Launched for Asia-Pacific by ATLATL and Samsung Bioepis

ATLATL and Samsung Bioepis have jointly launched the 'Samsung Bioepis Innovation Prize C-Lab Outside' initiative. This program aims to foster and accelerate early-stage biotechnology innovation across the Asia-Pacific region. The prize seeks to support promising ventures in the biotech sector.
